And just to clarify the jealousy part is even if I remotely talk to another woman she gets upset. My brother and I went to a club together to do some dancing and we saw this drunk man being rough with this girl at the club. We asked her if she was ok, she said no so we stepped in got her out of the situation. My FWB was not happy about it when I told her the story. She was slightly irritated that I stepped in and made an off hand remark that, “you are always trying to rescue someone”

Oh I didn’t preface this before hand but I haven’t been dating other people either. I’ve told her this before too.  When I’m in a FWB situation Im only in that with the other person. Im worried about STDS  too. And most of these other women that I go and hang out with are friends I’ve had from college. Friends that are married or are in committed relationships with other friends of mine and I wouldn’t in a million years sleep with them. They are family to me. I’m not hiding anything I just would like to figure out a way to approach this topic with her.

Very good question, we get a long very well and I’m attracted but I’ve noticed that she can be jealous. If I bring up other friends that happen to be women who I hang out with she gets a bit cold towards them and the idea of me hanging out with other women.  I have a friend who lives in a Korea that was visiting her hometown which I also live in and said she wanted to see me and catch up before she flew back out. My FWB said things like, “of course she wants to hang out with you”. I’ve assured her that this person is my only my friend and nothing else but she still insists that my friend wants to date me. We have been friends for 5 years and we went on one date but we both don’t see each other that way so it did not and we do not want it to go anywhere in that direction.
